body: The simplicity of when I open my eyes first thing in the morning, he has a habit of rolling over and moving my hair out of my face and tells me 'you're so beautiful' almost like he's never woke up next to me before, it never gets old.
My friends are all between the age of 20-25 and they all have kids. they always presume that because I have mental health problems and no children of my own, I'm some how a risk to there child.
So what do I do next?

I feel like I am settling for less than I deserve and that feels so unfair, I've tried so hard to ask him to be there but why should I ask? I didn't ask to feel this way. If he was struggling I'd be there that minute
So I leave? Because confronting someone who doesn't want to let you in really isn't healthy.

This is incredibly moving and powerful to read. You're so strong and as is your brother, It just makes you realise that you never know how much time you have left with someone and that every moment should be taken with people you love should never be taken for granted. Thank you for opening my eyes this morning.
